claims: BravesVision is the Atlanta Braves' new in-house television network for the 2026 season.
BravesVision and Braves.TV provide local no-blackout streaming and TV coverage across Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and western North Carolina.
BravesVision is available on Xfinity channel 1254.
BravesVision is available on DirecTV channel 645.
BravesVision is available on U-Verse channel 1730.
BravesVision replaces the former regional sports network FanDuel Sports Network for the 2026 season.
BravesVision games are available via linear cable/satellite.
BravesVision games are available via a direct-to-consumer streaming option on Braves.TV.
The Braves.TV subscription allows fans within Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and western North Carolina to watch games without local blackouts.
BravesVision covers Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and western North Carolina.
A season subscription to Braves.TV is $99.99.
Cable/satellite provider agreements for BravesVision were finalized immediately before the 2026 opening day.
Fubo includes BravesVision in its package.
BravesVision covers pregame shows "Braves On Deck".
BravesVision was created in under 30 days.
